## Course path

The shared course structure will move through:

1. Starting Point
2. Linux & Computer Systems
3. Git, GitHub & Portfolio
4. Python Foundations
5. Logic & Digital Systems
6. Python, Data & DataFrames
7. Machine Learning
8. Major Project & Portfolio

Grade 12 work can extend the shared foundation through more independent technical investigation and project depth.

Detailed lessons and the course sidebar are added in the next curriculum iteration.
